_vehicle: Quadrotor (Phillips App. C.4 electric quad) — use with src_quadrotorPID (bin/quadPID). Pairs with the flight-sim examples/quadrotor physics. Single-precision float32 UDP: receives the 21-field ekf_both state on 5001, sends 4 rotor throttles on 5002 (no entity id, matching the example's entity_tagged:false).
_status: PROVISIONAL control law — builds and hovers/attitude-corrects in synthetic tests, but the gains, a_thrust, and kappa are first-guess values that still need TUNING against the sim. Not flight-validated.

udp.packet_in_notes: 21 float32: t, u,v,w, p,q,r, x,y,z, e0,ex,ey,ez, rotor1..4, pdot,qdot,rdot (pdot/qdot/rdot unused by this PID law)
udp.packet_out_notes: 4 float32 rotor throttles [0..1] in order rotor1,rotor2,rotor3,rotor4

pilot_inputs.mapping_notes: left stick Y = climb rate, left stick X = yaw rate, right stick Y = pitch, right stick X = roll. No mode buttons (single control mode).

vehicle.Ixx_notes: matches the assembled inertia of examples/quadrotor (Phillips Table C.4.3)
vehicle.kappa_notes: yaw reaction torque per unit rotor thrust [ft]; TUNE against the sim prop torque
vehicle.a_thrust_notes: rotor thrust model f = a_thrust * throttle^2 [lbf]; chosen so 4 * a * 0.46^2 = 5 lbf hover (sim hover throttle ~0.46). TUNE to the sim's actual thrust curve.

climb._note: climb-rate PI -> vertical acceleration [ft/s^2] -> collective thrust

stick_limits.tilt_rate_max_dps_note: slew limit on bank/pitch command; releasing the stick eases back to level over ~tilt_max/tilt_rate seconds (25/60 ~ 0.42 s) instead of snapping the setpoint to zero. Lower = gentler.
